تمتحنوا (form VIII)
# تَمْتَحِنُوا (tamtaḥinū) /tam.ta.ħi.nuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَحَنَ (imtaḥana)
# تُمْتَحَنُوا (tumtaḥanū) /tum.ta.ħa.nuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَحَنَ (imtaḥana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
